We are looking for a strategic, analytical, and highly collaborative B2B Growth Marketer to build and scale our SMB acquisition engine. This is a foundational role on the Paid Performance Marketing team and the first dedicated marketer focused on bringing small and medium-sized businesses to Pinterest.
What you’ll do
Demonstrated experience developing, managing, or setting strategy for paid acquisition programs, with particular depth in Google Search, Performance Max, and other Google Ads products. Experience with Meta, LinkedIn, and Reddit is a plus.
Define and lead the B2B acquisition strategy for SMBs, identifying the highest-potential customer segments, use cases, markets, messages, and channels to drive efficient growth.
Build an integrated SMB acquisition roadmap centered on paid media and complemented by owned channels, partner opportunities, and other scalable levers.
Develop compelling SMB value propositions and campaign narratives that clearly articulate why businesses should advertise on Pinterest.
Own creative strategy in partnership with Creative.
Own performance measurement across the acquisition funnel, including qualified sign-ups, activation, early advertiser success, cost efficiency, and downstream business value.
Design and execute a rigorous testing agenda to improve targeting, creative, landing experiences, incentives, onboarding, and channel mix.
Partner with Product Marketing, Product, Analytics, Sales, Business Development, Creative, Finance, and regional teams to bring programs to market and turn learnings into action.
Translate customer research, market signals, and campaign data into actionable insights that inform growth strategy and product priorities.
Establish clear operating rhythms, dashboards, and executive-ready communications that keep stakeholders aligned on performance, risks, decisions, and opportunities.
Use AI and automation thoughtfully to accelerate research, analysis, ideation, and operational workflows, while applying sound judgment and maintaining ownership of output quality.
What we’re looking for
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Marketing, Business, Economics, Communications, Analytics, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
Minimum 7 years of experience in growth marketing, demand generation, performance marketing, lifecycle marketing, product marketing, or a related B2B marketing discipline.
Demonstrated experience acquiring and activating small-business, self-serve, or B2B customers in a measurable, performance-oriented environment.
Strong command of growth strategy and experimentation, including audience segmentation, funnel analysis, channel optimization, messaging, and conversion-rate improvement.
Exceptional analytical judgment: able to define success metrics, synthesize quantitative and qualitative signals, and make clear tradeoffs amid ambiguity.
Track record of leading cross-functional initiatives without direct authority and aligning diverse stakeholders around a shared plan.
Ability to move fluidly between strategy and execution—setting the direction while remaining close to the details of campaigns, creative, measurement, and customer experience.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders with clear, concise recommendations.
Demonstrated experience using AI-enabled tools to accelerate marketing workflows or customer analysis, alongside a clear approach to validating accuracy, protecting quality, and applying critical thinking.
Preferred qualifications
Experience marketing advertising, marketplace, SaaS, creator, ecommerce, or other self-serve business products.
Experience building a new growth motion, channel, or customer segment from an early stage through scale.
Familiarity with SMB needs, barriers, and buying behavior.
Experience working in a global, matrixed organization.

About Pinterest
Millions of people come to Pinterest to find inspiration and make their ideas a reality. Our mission is to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love—and the partnerships we build play an important role in making that possible. We are looking for a strategic, commercially minded Business Development Lead to identify, structure, and scale partnerships that create meaningful value for Pinners, customers, partners, and Pinterest.
What you’ll do
Develop partnership strategies, with guidance from your manager, that define the highest-priority partnership areas, target partners, and value-exchange frameworks aligned to Pinterest’s business goals.
Research and evaluate new partnership opportunities by analyzing customer needs, market dynamics, strategic fit, operational feasibility, and financial impact; translate findings into clear business cases and recommendations.
Lead the commercial development of partnership opportunities, including shaping proposals, aligning internal stakeholders, negotiating terms, and driving deals to close with support from relevant subject-matter experts and leadership.
Manage a portfolio of partnerships and/or partnership programs, owning key execution deliverables, operating rhythms, performance monitoring, and issue resolution to realize agreed value.
Build trusted, productive relationships with external partners and cross-functional teams across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Legal, Finance, Privacy, Policy, Operations, and other relevant functions.
Identify partner and stakeholder needs, articulate how Pinterest can address them, and present solutions that connect directly to shared business objectives and challenges.
Establish clear success metrics, milestones, and feedback mechanisms for the partnerships you lead; surface risks early, hold stakeholders accountable to commitments, and adapt plans based on results.
Make thoughtful, timely recommendations in ambiguous situations by synthesizing quantitative analysis, market context, stakeholder input, and experience; raise and address difficult tradeoffs directly when needed.
Represent the voice of partners and customers internally, bringing forward insights that can improve Pinterest’s products, commercial strategy, and partner experience.
Contribute functional expertise to the broader Business Development team by sharing negotiation, market-analysis, account-management, and stakeholder-management best practices with peers.
What we’re looking for
Minimum 10 years of experience in business development, strategic partnerships, corporate development, management consulting, investment banking, strategy, or a related commercial function.
Demonstrated experience independently evaluating, structuring, negotiating, and managing complex strategic or commercial partnerships.
Strong strategic and analytical skills, including the ability to assess market and customer conditions, build a compelling business case, and convert analysis into practical recommendations.
Proven ability to manage external accounts or partners while balancing partner objectives with Pinterest’s business interests.
Excellent executive communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex commercial, strategic, and operational issues clearly to diverse audiences.
Strong cross-functional leadership skills and a track record of influencing without direct authority across senior internal and external stakeholders.
Sound judgment and comfort making decisions amid incomplete information, competing priorities, and evolving conditions.
A resilient, accountable, and low-ego approach: you stay calm through setbacks, own outcomes, give direct feedback constructively, and respectfully seek out different perspectives.
Experience in consumer internet, advertising, commerce, creator ecosystems, platform partnerships, or technology is preferred.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience; MBA or other advanced degree is a plus.

Pinterest is where hundreds of millions of people around the world discover ideas and turn inspiration into action. Our mission is to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and our values guide how we build, operate, and lead: Put Pinners First, Aim for Extraordinary, Create Belonging, Act as One, and Win or Learn.
Ads brings together Product and Engineering to build the products and systems that power Pinterest’s advertising platform across advertiser and Pinner experiences, enabling sustainable growth while protecting the quality and integrity of the product experience. This organization sits at the intersection of business strategy, scaled engineering systems, and product innovation, making it one of Pinterest’s most business-critical teams.
About the Role
We are hiring a Chief of Staff to the GM, Ads (Product, Engineering, Data Science) to help scale the organization, sharpen executive decision-making, and drive the operating agenda for this high-impact team. This Chief of Staff (CoS) will act as a senior strategic operator and trusted advisor who connects big-picture priorities with day-to-day execution, serving as a force multiplier for the GM and the broader leadership team.
The role is designed for a leader who can:
Operate as a thought partner to senior executives, with strong business and technical intuition
Build and run scalable operating mechanisms that drive clarity, accountability, and outcomes
Translate complex, ambiguous challenges into structured decisions, owners, and execution plans
Represent the organization in critical cross-functional forums with confidence and credibility across senior technical and business leaders
What You’ll Do
Serve as a strategic partner and force multiplier to the GM, Ads and the broader Ads leadership team, helping them stay focused on the most important company and organizational priorities.
Own and continuously refine the executive operating agenda in partnership with leaders and TPMs, including strategic planning, goal setting, quarterly and annual business reviews, leadership offsites, and decision forums.
Lead high-priority, cross-functional initiatives that improve Ad’s execution across Product and Engineering, operating effectiveness, and business impact, stepping in to drive structure, alignment, and momentum where ambiguity is highest.
Translate ambiguous business, technical, and organizational problems into clear frameworks, options, recommendations, and decisions for the VP and leadership team.
Use data, qualitative insight, and organizational “listening” to identify risks, diagnose operating gaps, and proactively surface tradeoffs and implications to leadership.
Build alignment across Engineering, Product, Design, Data Science, Finance, Recruiting, People, and GTM partners, ensuring the Ads organization’s priorities, risks, and resource needs are well understood and integrated into company planning.
Design, implement, and evolve operating mechanisms that improve prioritization, decision quality, communication, and follow-through (for example, leadership cadences, decision logs, roadmap and investment reviews, and accountability trackers).
Support organizational planning and growth, including team structure, headcount and investment tradeoffs, leadership effectiveness, and operating-model evolution as the business and technology landscape changes.
Develop executive-level communications and narratives (for example, decision memos, business reviews, strategy updates, board and ET prep) that clarify strategy, progress, tradeoffs, and decisions for varied audiences.
Represent the Ads organization in critical forums with the Office of the CEO, other functional Chiefs of Staff, and cross-functional leadership groups, modeling the high standards of quality, efficiency, and operational rigor expected of the Office of the CEO and broader executive community.
Act as a culture carrier for Pinterest’s values, helping the organization Put Pinners First, Aim for Extraordinary, Create Belonging, Act as One, and Win or Learn in how it plans, executes, and communicates.
Collaborate with finance teams to manage budgets, optimize spending, and identify opportunities for efficiency and/or investment.
Understand, interface and work closely with recruiting and people orgs to evaluate and nurture healthy, cooperative engineering teams.
What We’re Looking For
Minimum 8 years of experience in strategic operations, business operations, program leadership, product operations, technical program management, consulting, finance, or a related role in complex, fast-moving organizations.
Experience operating as a trusted partner to senior executives or leadership teams, with a track record of shaping priorities, driving decisions, and landing complex, cross-functional programs.
Strong strategic judgment and systems thinking, with the ability to connect company and Ads priorities, organizational dynamics, technical realities, and execution constraints into a coherent plan.
Proven ability to lead high-impact initiatives from ambiguous problem definition through measurable outcomes, including establishing clear success metrics, governance, and accountability mechanisms.
Exceptional analytical skills; able to use both quantitative and qualitative data to diagnose issues, frame options, and influence decisions with clear, structured recommendations.
Outstanding executive communication skills, including the ability to craft concise narratives, decision memos, business reviews, and leadership communications for technical and non-technical audiences.
Demonstrated ability to influence without formal authority, build trust quickly, and drive alignment across senior stakeholders with competing priorities and perspectives.
Experience designing and scaling operating mechanisms, planning processes, or organizational systems that improve focus, execution, and cross-functional alignment.
High integrity, discretion, and judgment; comfortable operating with access to sensitive information and navigating nuanced people, organizational, and business situations.
Comfort working at the intersection of technical, product, and business environments; you do not need to be the deepest technical expert, but you must be able to engage credibly with senior engineering and product leaders.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
Preferred Qualifications
Experience partnering directly with Engineering, Product, or other technical executive teams as a Chief of Staff, strategic advisor, or senior TPM/strategic operations leader.
Experience in advertising, marketplace, platform, infrastructure, or other scaled technology environments where monetization, reliability, and user experience must be balanced thoughtfully.
Experience with organizational design, headcount planning, business planning, or executive-level operating rhythms (for example, OKR cycles, QBRs, investment reviews, or board/ET prep).
Experience partnering with Finance, Recruiting, People, or GTM teams on business-critical initiatives that span strategy, operations, talent, and culture.

In this role, you will shape and drive a unified technical strategy across Ads Quality, leading teams responsible for engagement ranking, oCPM and conversion modeling, ROAS optimization, lightweight ranking and retrieval models, foundation model adoption, sequence and multimodal modeling, and the quality and efficiency of production machine learning systems.

Experience with conversion, value, ROAS, bidding, or other lower-funnel optimization problems is strongly preferred.
Proven ability to connect modeling objectives and offline metrics to online experiments and business outcomes.
Experience operating production ML systems with demanding requirements for latency, availability, calibration, privacy, reliability, and cost.
Strong judgment in balancing near-term product delivery with foundational technical investments.
Track record of building high-performing organizations, developing senior leaders, and creating effective operating mechanisms.

As a Lead Creative Producer on Pinterest’s House of Creative team, you will lead end-to-end creative production for complex, high-impact marketing programs across multiple channels and workstreams. This role is built for a producer who is equally strong at production execution and in-house cross-functional leadership. You will partner closely with Creative, Marketing, Product, Comms, Media, Legal, Finance, and external production partners to move work from early concept through final delivery.
Success in this role is not only getting the work made. It is creating clarity around how the work gets made: establishing a shared plan, keeping milestones and dependencies visible, aligning the right decision-makers, surfacing risks and tradeoffs early, and ensuring cross-functional teams understand what is happening, what is changing, and what is needed from them.
What you’ll do:
Lead creative production from concept through delivery across large, integrated marketing campaigns and programs spanning film/video, photography, social, digital, experiential, and other brand expressions
Set production strategy across multiple concurrent programs, including scoping, resourcing, budgets, schedules and vendor planning
Build integrated production plans that clarify roles, milestones, dependencies, decisions and handoffs for cross-functional partners
Serve as a key connective point across in-house Creative, Marketing, Product, Comms, Media, Legal, Finance, and other partner teams, creating clarity around roles, milestones, dependencies, decisions, and handoffs
Partner with senior creative and marketing leaders to pressure-test ambition, feasibility, timing, and investment and translate changes into clear production implications and tradeoffs
Identify risks early, recommend solutions and escalate decisions at the right time to protect quality, timelines and budget
Lead external production partners, including agencies, production companies, photographers, directors and specialist vendors
Advocate for the highest level of creative craft while balancing business priorities, production realities, budgets, and timelines
Use AI thoughtfully to accelerate appropriate production workflows such as planning, research, synthesis, documentation, and repetitive tasks while maintaining critical judgment, accuracy, confidentiality, and ownership of final outcome
Mentor and support other producers and contribute to the evolution of production standards, tools, and practices across House of Creative
What we’re looking for:
A minimum of 8 years of experience in integrated creative production across in-house brand or marketing organizations and/or agency teams
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as marketing, communications or production, or equivalent experience
Robust hands-on production experience across large, multi-channel campaigns, with deep knowledge of film/video production and strong fluency across photography, social, digital, experiential, and other integrated formats
Demonstrated success operating within, or deeply embedded with, complex in-house creative and marketing organizations
Experience leading highly cross-functional programs and creating alignment across teams with different goals, timelines, and decision-makers
Exceptional communication and stakeholder-management skills, including a track record of proactively keeping teams aligned on schedules, milestones, dependencies, changes, and decisions
Strong production judgment with the ability to independently manage budgets, scopes, resources, vendors, timelines, and risk
Ability to influence without authority, navigate ambiguity, and know when an issue should be resolved at the working level versus escalated for leadership decision
Experience managing external agencies and production partners while maintaining strong internal relationships and accountability

This role sits at the intersection of Creative, Technology, Marketing, and Operations, partnering closely with Digital Strategy, Design, and cross-functional teams to turn business and creative ambition into scalable, executable digital experiences.
The Business Site will be the primary priority, but the remit is broader than a single website. This producer will also lead production across campaign and launch experiences, event and registration platforms, newsroom and other digital touchpoints that require strong creative, technical, and operational leadership.

Lead end-to-end digital production from early definition through launch across websites, campaign experiences, event/registration platforms, and other digital touchpoints

Partner closely with Digital Strategy and Site leads on roadmap execution, sequencing, feasibility, platform implications, and production tradeoffs
Partner deeply with Design and UX to determine how creative ideas can be realized across responsive experiences, design systems, reusable components, and technical constraints
Evaluate platforms, vendors, and implementation approaches against business, creative, technical, operational, and financial requirements; help determine when to use an existing platform, third-party solution, or custom build
Bring working fluency across CMS environments, integrations/APIs, analytics and tracking, accessibility, localization, privacy/legal requirements, QA, SEO, and digital release processes
Serve as the connective tissue across Strategy, Design, Engineering, Analytics, SEO, Marketing, Comms, Legal/Privacy, Localization, and external partners, creating clear ownership, milestones, dependencies, decisions, and handoffs
Anticipate technical and operational risk, surface tradeoffs early, and ensure changes in scope, timing, requirements, or platform capability lead to explicit decisions rather than downstream teams silently absorbing the impact
Build strong production rhythms and repeatable systems that improve visibility, accountability, speed, and scalability across the digital portfolio
Manage and evaluate external digital agencies, development partners, platforms, and specialist vendors
Use AI thoughtfully to accelerate appropriate digital-production workflows such as research, requirements synthesis, planning, documentation, QA support, and repetitive tasks while maintaining critical judgment, accuracy, privacy, and ownership of final outcomes

A minimum of 7 years of experience in digital production, web production, creative technology production, or a closely related discipline across agency and/or in-house teams
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as marketing, communications, digital media or a related field, or equivalent experience
Demonstrated experience leading complex digital experiences end to end, including large websites, platform implementations, campaign experiences, event/registration experiences, or comparable digital products
Strong technical fluency and the ability to evaluate platforms, vendors, integrations, CMS approaches, implementation complexity, and technical risk without needing to be the engineer
Proven ability to lead highly cross-functional programs across Strategy, Design/UX, Engineering, Marketing, Analytics, SEO, Legal/Privacy, Localization, and external partners
Strong strategic judgment and the ability to translate ambiguous business needs into clear production options, recommendations, and tradeoffs
Excellent communication and leadership presence, including the ability to influence without authority and make complex technical or operational issues understandable to senior stakeholders
Experience in using AI to improve the speed and quality of research, planning, documentation or other core work
Strong operational discipline across scoping, resourcing, budgets, schedules, dependencies, QA, launch readiness, and risk management
Experience evaluating and managing digital agencies, development partners, platforms, and vendors
Comfortable operating autonomously across multiple workstreams and serving as a trusted digital-production partner to senior Creative, Marketing, and Digital Strategy leaders

The Responsible AI team is part of the Advanced Technologies Group (ATG), Pinterest’s advanced machine learning team. ATG’s goal is to keep Pinterest at the forefront of machine learning technology across multiple use cases including recommendations, ranking, content understanding, and more. It is an applied team that works horizontally across the company on state of the art AI and ML and works on directly bringing that technology to the product in collaboration with product engineering teams. The team also publishes its work in applied research conferences, but the main goal of the team is to have a direct impact on business metrics.
At Pinterest our goal is to inspire pinners (our users) to live the life they love. The product is powered by state of the art ML algorithms which are used to understand both the billions of visually rich items on the platform and the interests of our 535M+ monthly active users and recommend inspiring personalized content to them. What this means is that ML at Pinterest is not only multi-modal utilizing image, text, and graph signals as input, but it needs to operate at a very large scale and often in a real time interactive user experience.
Pinterest is known for being a positive and inspirational place on the internet and we believe that inspiration begins with representation and belonging. The Responsible AI team is a horizontal team that collaborates across the company on various initiatives. These range from Generative AI alignment, evaluation, and mitigations - ensuring these models are safe, bias-free, and aligned with Pinterest’s vision and policies - to championing ML Fairness and developing user-facing features that enhance our product for all users. This includes launching groundbreaking features such as user-controllable skin tone , hair pattern search refinements, and more recently, body type .
You’ll help shape forward-thinking projects, develop advanced ML approaches rooted in fairness and equitability, and pioneer responsible AI safeguards for emerging technologies. By joining this team, you’ll make a lasting impact on our Pinners, our business, and the evolution of ethical AI at Pinterest.
What you'll do:
execute on projects in the responsible AI frontier, to identify, avoid, and mitigate bias across a wide range of ML applications at Pinterest including generative AI.
Collaborate with other engineering teams (trust and safety, user modeling, content understanding,) to leverage their platforms and signals and work with them to collaborate on the adoption and evaluation of Responsible AI practices and ML Fairness tooling across Pinterest.
Mentor junior engineers on the Responsible AI team and across the company on the R-AI space.
Work with the team and senior leaders at the company to define and drive technical strategy in this area.
What we're looking for:
Extensive, real-world experience applying advanced ML methods to production systems, with a strong track record in responsible technology - spanning fairness, ethics, and broader societal considerations.
Deep familiarity with cutting-edge ML architectures (e.g., transformer-based models, 2-tower architectures, LLMs) and their applications in large-scale Search and Recommender Systems.
Proven ability to measure, deploy, and refine fairness interventions and broader Responsible AI solutions at scale, bridging state-of-the-art research with tangible product impact.
2+ years working experience in the engineering teams that build large-scale ML-driven user-facing products
Masters or PhD in Comp Sci or related fields

Publications at top ML conferences

Pinterest helps Pinners discover and do what they love. The Content Foundation ML team is responsible for understanding the semantic meaning of Pinterest content and generating high-quality, reusable signals and insights that power relevance and personalization across the platform. We work at the intersection of machine learning, large multimodal models, data infrastructure, and product adoption to build foundational content understanding capabilities that support Discovery, Search, Growth, and Ads. We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager who can drive the team’s technical direction, lead the team in building scalable content understanding systems, and make an impact on core Pinterest user and business outcomes.
What will you be doing:
Lead, mentor and grow a team of engineers and applied scientists in developing foundational content understanding signals, infrastructure and systems that are integral to key Pinterest products across Discovery, Search, Growth, and Ads.
Provide thought leadership in content understanding and machine learning by setting a long-term technical vision for semantic signal generation, reusable foundational layers, and scalable model-powered infrastructure. Partner closely with product, data science, and downstream engineering teams to ensure these signals drive meaningful impact across Pinterest.
Manage project execution and stakeholder communication, including roadmap planning, technical decision-making, risk mitigation, and progress updates to achieve business goals.
Help the team solve difficult technical challenges such as:
How to leverage the latest VLM and LLM technologies to understand the full semantic richness of Pinterest content and generate high-quality signals with strong precision, recall and coverage across multiple locales?
How to build reusable foundational layers such as captions, summaries and semantic descriptors that can power multiple downstream use cases efficiently and at low infra cost?
How to improve inference throughput, freshness and serving efficiency so that content understanding signals can keep up with millions of new Pins and evolving content every day?
How to measure and improve the downstream impact of content understanding signals on relevance, personalization, engagement and ads performance across different surfaces?
How to build robust monitoring, evaluation and debugging systems that ensure signal quality, accessibility, latency and freshness at scale?
What we’re looking for:
7+ years of industry experience, including 2+ years of management experience.
Masters degree in computer science, computer engineering, or equivalent work experience
Publication at top machine learning and data mining conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, KDD, SIGIR)
Experience with:
Large scale distributed training and inference of LLM and VLM models.
Distributed tooling for ML data pipelines, e.g. Hadoop, Spark.

Leverage data-driven insights to craft actionable recommendations and guide clients toward sustained programmatic growth and ROI.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, championing Pinterest’s value in the programmatic marketplace and identifying new growth opportunities.
AI-first programmatic and CTV selling: Uses internal AI and agentic tools to prep for exec-level conversations, including account research, partner mapping, POVs, and QBR narratives tied to full-funnel goals and deal strategy.
AI-powered campaign insights (full funnel): Applies AI to quickly analyze programmatic and CTV performance (pacing, win rates, audience/creative signals, conversion trends) and turn findings into clear optimization and investment recommendations, validated against source-of-truth reporting and measurement (including Clean Rooms).
AI for forecasting, QA, and trend-based recommendations: Uses AI-driven insights and strategic frameworks to validate performance and revenue, forecast pipeline and live deal outcomes (pacing, win rates, spend/revenue outlook), and translate programmatic marketplace trends into QBR-ready recommendations for senior stakeholders.

Advanced understanding of full-funnel digital advertising solutions, including brand, consideration, and conversion strategies, with specialized knowledge in search, shopping, display, or (social a plus).
Proven track record of building and nurturing executive-level relationships with advertisers and agency programmatic centers, developing long-term strategic plans, and negotiating high-value partnership agreements to drive measurable business outcomes.
Strong understanding of data and measurement solutions including Clean Rooms.
Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities; skilled at translating data, macro trends, and campaign performance insights into actionable recommendations that fuel ongoing revenue growth.
Strong consultative approach with the ability to educate, influence, and challenge executive stakeholders while crafting visionary and results-oriented media strategies.
Excellent communicator and collaborator, thriving in fast-paced environments while ensuring operational excellence, seamless cross-functional teamwork, and project management success.
AI for scenario planning (“what-if”): Uses AI to structure ambiguous client questions and run scenario planning for programmatic/CTV investment (funnel mix, reach vs. frequency, budget shifts, incrementality assumptions), generating testable hypotheses that inform GTM and negotiations.

This role is responsible for driving innovation and execution across offsite signals, content understanding, and relevance, with direct impact on multiple company OKRs. Strategic Leadership & Vision
Envision and trailblaze the company’s approach to leveraging offsite and onsite signals, anticipating future business, technical, and regulatory challenges.

Oversee and deliver company-level programs that span multiple organizations, managing ambiguity and risk at scale.

Influence at the VP/staff level, providing thought leadership in program and product management across Pinterest.

Evangelize the vision and progress of signals programs to all levels of leadership, including the Executive Team, ensuring clear, concise, and impactful communication.
Drive consensus and propose informed tradeoffs across the company, balancing technical, business, and regulatory considerations.
Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including Product, Engineering, Legal, Privacy, and external data partners.
Technical & Domain Expertise
Demonstrate expert technical understanding and judgment, guiding teams in solving complex technical challenges that span organizations.
Author and advance best practices, tools, and methodologies for signals management, data acquisition, and model evaluation.
Shape the future of the signals domain at Pinterest through continuous research, learning, and mentorship of program managers and technical leads.
AI-first execution & workflow design
Use GenAI as the default operating model for TPM execution—starting from AI-assisted first drafts of core artifacts (charters, roadmaps, status reports, decision memos, RAID logs) and modernizing high-toil workflows (status synthesis, risk/dependency tracking, intake triage) into AI-first mechanisms where appropriate.
Prototype lightweight AI-powered helpers and tools (“vibe coding”) to improve signal quality monitoring, experiment readouts, and decision-making across Search and Signals.

BS in a technical discipline or equivalent experience (10+ years in technical or analytical roles, with significant program leadership at company scale).

Deep technical breadth and judgment, with expertise in search, recommendation systems, ML/AI, and large-scale data integration.
AI-forward execution mindset – demonstrated ability to use GenAI to accelerate planning, program operations, and stakeholder communications at company scale—starting from AI drafts and applying strong judgment to validate, refine, and drive decisions.

Safety-by-design AI fluency – experience operating within AI governance expectations (risk assessment, sensitive data handling, model/output validation, auditability/traceability) and proactively identifying where AI use is not appropriate or requires additional controls.
Proven track record of influencing at the VP/staff level and driving consensus across complex, cross-functional environments.
Exceptional communication, relationship-building, and organizational awareness.
Experience with legal, privacy, and regulatory compliance in data-driven environments.
Experience working with external data partners and negotiating data acquisition agreements is highly desirable.
Experience with internationalization and supporting global product relevance is a plus
Experience working with Search products at a low level of detail highly desirable
Experience with data acquisition, integration, and management, especially for offsite signals, is a plus

Role Summary
As a Client Partner at Pinterest, you will serve as a strategic visionary, cultivating trusted relationships with top-tier auto manufacturers and national retailers through your deep expertise in full-funnel sales. By leveraging your nuanced understanding of client businesses, you will independently engage assigned customer accounts to promote Pinterest products effectively. Your primary responsibilities include meeting performance targets, developing new business, maintaining and expanding customer relationships, and resolving specific customer issues. By guiding clients’ efforts, you'll drive value for millions of Pinners seeking inspiration and action, forming strategic alliances both internally and externally. Success in this role depends on your ability to drive substantial revenue growth and spearhead a vision for long-term client success in a collaborative, dynamic environment.
What you'll do:
Strategic Vision and Partnership Building
Develop and execute full-funnel sales strategies that encompass awareness, consideration, conversion, and retention for automotive clients, driving measurable business results.
Cultivate and maintain strong relationships across client and agency stakeholders, including C-suite, Investment, Strategy, and Activation teams, organizing key educational summits, strategy sessions, and QBRs.
Build and execute a strategic business plan to drive revenue growth on Pinterest. Get buy-in from key stakeholders (internally and externally) to your strategic approach and drive accountability through influence. Drive y/y growth and spearhead annual deal conversations.
Demonstrate executive presence, leadership and influence with clients by understanding the ins and outs of their business that includes but is not limited to macro trends (headwinds, tailwinds), business goals & media KPIs, opportunities, etc to think critically, the status quo and not take client directives at face value.
Product Expertise and Market Influence
Serve as a product expert, delivering guidance on digital ecosystem and Pinterest's ad offerings, focusing on both upper and lower funnel formats, and staying at the forefront of industry trends to address partner needs.
Develop tailored media strategies leveraging industry insights to achieve business goals, driving adoption and scaling Pinterest’s performance media solutions (search, Shopping, feed-based ads).
Internal and External Collaboration
Spearhead negotiations and develop joint business plans to foster an understanding of partner goals, maximizing impact while mobilizing cross-functional teams to address complex challenges.
Drive business growth by analyzing partner goals, delivering data-driven insights, and crafting compelling narratives to guide successful media strategies.
Champion Pinterest’s Value
Champion Pinterest's value proposition by showcasing impactful ad metrics and positioning Pinterest as a key player in advertisers’ media mix.
Proactively identify and communicate opportunities for incremental growth, working closely with clients to expand partnerships.
What we are looking for:
Ad sales and Digital Advertising Expertise: Deep understanding of full funnel advertising solutions that includes media and measurement solutions for brand, consideration and conversion. Nice to have specialized knowledge/expertise in search, shopping, display and/or social.
Strong Consultative and Negotiation Skills: Proven track record of developing long-term partnerships and effectively negotiating annual partnership agreements, ensuring mutual satisfaction and driving high-value client engagements.
Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills : Ability to think critically and analytically by leveraging insights, macro trends and micro performance trends to translate learnings into actionable insights to propel revenue growth.
Goal and Result-Oriented Approach: Demonstrated ability to consistently achieve revenue goals while balancing both short and long-term growth objectives to foster continued partnership development. This includes a strategic, results-oriented approach to client and media management, ensuring sustainable success and mutually beneficial outcomes.
Excellent Communication and Collaboration Skills: Able to thrive in fast-paced environments, maintaining high standards of operational excellence, strategic thinking, and fostering a collaborative team atmosphere.
Challenger mindset: willing to challenge and stay persistent with key decision makers. Client Partners will continually evolve their relationships (client, agency and creative decision makers), drive weekly accountability with action plans and get creative where there are gaps in product or capabilities.
AI Enthusiast: Demonstrates a strong curiosity for and practical application of AI to improve productivity, streamline workflows, and elevate client communications, presentations, and recommendations. Uses AI thoughtfully across account strategy and sales motions to uncover insights, sharpen strategic narratives, and show up as a strong, trusted advisor while maintaining sound judgment and a high bar for quality.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as digital media or SAAS sales, or equivalent experience.

We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.
This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 2 times per week and therefore needs to be in a commutable distance from our NYC office.

About tvScientific
tvScientific is the first and only CTV advertising platform purpose-built for performance marketers. We leverage massive data and cutting-edge science to automate and optimize TV advertising to drive business outcomes. Our solution combines media buying, optimization, measurement, and attribution in one, efficient platform. Our platform is built by industry leaders with a long history in programmatic advertising, digital media, and ad verification who have now purpose-built a CTV performance platform advertisers can trust to grow their business.
Role Summary
Join the tvScientific team as a Senior Account Executive on our CPA team, where you'll play a pivotal role in driving new business and revenue growth. In this position, you will focus on building and closing high-value client relationships within the cost-per-acquisition (CPA) space, utilizing your deep experience in the affiliate and performance marketing sectors. (You can read more about our CPA approach here: https://www.tvscientific.com/insight/cost-per-acquisition )
You will be responsible for identifying, prospecting, and acquiring new clients, while also developing strategic relationships and positioning tvScientific’s cutting-edge platform as a top solution to meet client needs. Success in this role means consistently exceeding sales quotas, driving market expansion, and contributing significantly to the long-term growth and success of tvScientific.
What you'll do:
Lead the prospecting, qualification, and closing of new affiliate CPA client accounts, targeting high-value opportunities and key industry players.
Deep understanding of the digital media and advertising landscape, with experience talking to customers and agencies about digital media, including CTV advertising.
Deep knowledge of industry trends, market dynamics, and the full ad tech landscape (DSPs, SSPs, auction mechanics, deal structures).
Drive the sales process from lead generation to deal closure, presenting tailored solutions and articulating the value of tvScientific’s platform to meet client objectives.
Build and nurture strong, long-lasting relationships with prospective and new clients, ensuring a seamless handoff to the account management team post-sale.
Develop a strategic approach to building a robust sales pipeline, leveraging your knowledge of the affiliate marketing ecosystem and market trends to uncover opportunities.
Work closely with internal teams, including Account Management, Product, and Support, to ensure successful onboarding and campaign execution for new clients.
Maintain a thorough understanding of client needs, industry trends, and competitors to position tvScientific as the preferred partner for performance marketing solutions.
Consistently meet or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales quotas, contributing to the overall revenue growth of the affiliate CPA team.
Participate in high-level sales presentations, industry events, and networking opportunities to expand tvScientific’s market presence.
Use AI to sharpen prospecting and outreach: Leverage AI tools to prioritize high-intent accounts, tailor outreach and pitch decks, and prep for discovery calls based on affiliate/CPA signals and market trends.
How We'll Define Success:
Consistently exceed sales targets, including monthly, quarterly, and annual quotas, for new client acquisition and revenue growth.
Successfully manage the sales process from prospecting to closing, with a high conversion rate of leads into paying clients.
Establish and maintain strong relationships with new clients, ensuring a smooth transition and excellent long-term client satisfaction.
Proactively identify and close high-value business opportunities, contributing to the overall growth and expansion of the affiliate CPA team.
Act as a trusted advisor to prospective clients, offering industry insights and solutions that directly address their needs and challenges.
Receive positive feedback from both clients and internal stakeholders regarding your approach, professionalism, and the overall client experience.
What we're looking for:
5+ years of experience in affiliate sales or account management, with a proven track record in the performance marketing space.
Extensive experience in closing high-value affiliate CPA deals and managing complex client relationships.
Deep understanding of the affiliate marketing ecosystem, performance marketing principles, and the digital media landscape.

You will collaborate on a wide array of product and business problems with a diverse set of cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Design, Research, Product Analytics, Data Engineering and others. Bring scientific rigor and statistical methods to the challenges of product creation, development and improvement with an appreciation for the behaviors of our Pinners.
Build and prototype analysis pipelines iteratively to provide insights at scale while developing comprehensive knowledge of data structures and metrics, advocating for changes where needed for product development.
Work cross-functionally to build and communicate key insights, and collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, designers, and researchers to help build the next experiences on Pinterest.
Leverage AI to seek faster execution (i.e. draft, prototype, outline) and explore alternative options (i.e. iterate, compare approaches).
Leverage AI to synthesize information (summarize, distill themes) and automate repeatable tasks (documentation, reporting, QA checks).

5+ years of experience analyzing data in a fast-paced, data-driven environment with proven ability to apply scientific methods to solve real-world problems on web-scale data.
Extensive experience solving analytical problems using quantitative approaches including in the fields of Statistics, Machine Learning, Forecasting, Econometrics or other related fields.
Experience solving problems within digital advertising is preferred.
Familiarity with online experimentation and its pitfalls.
A scientifically and statistically rigorous approach to analysis and data. You rely on statistically valid approaches to problems and have a well-tuned sense of skepticism, attention to detail and commitment to high-quality, results-oriented output.

Strong track record of critical evaluation and verification of AI-assisted work (e.g., testing, source-checking, data validation, peer review).
High integrity and ownership: you protect sensitive data, avoid over-reliance on AI, and remain accountable for final decisions and deliverables.

Within Pinterest, the Pinterest Labs organization focuses on applied ML research and development. Labs focuses on a broad variety of AI/ML initiatives, such as core computer vision, multimodal representation learning, heterogeneous graph neural networks, generative modeling, recommender systems, etc. This is the group that develops foundation ML models that fully leverage the tens of billions of Pins and the associated knowledge graph to improve the core product.
We are currently hiring for the visual modeling team in Labs, which focuses on developing Pinterest Canvas. Canvas is a foundation text-to-image model developed internally for helping various visualization, inpainting, and outpainting products. In this role, you’ll get to work with Pinterest’s rich visual-text dataset to build large-scale generative models which are continuously being shipped to production to power visualization features. The core Canvas pod is a small group (~6 engineers along with a product prototyping team) inside of Labs, allowing for deep collaboration. For example, engineers working on the Canvas project also participate in the development of our core multimodal text & image embeddings, as these are in turn used to condition the model in unique ways.
What you’ll do:
Prototype new model architectures for Pinterest Canvas, our internal text-to-image generative model. We’re looking for hands-on experience working with diffusion text-to-image models and independent model implementation skills.
Read research papers, participate in group discussions, and help brainstorm our overall visual generative strategy at the company.
Help with collection of relevant visual training data for Pinterest Canvas, particularly to conduct RLHF, targeted fine-tuning, etc.
Publish and publicize your work via conferences, paper submissions, blog posts, etc.
Mentor more junior researchers or research interns within the Pinterest Labs organization.
What we’re looking for:
Research engineers and scientists who have experience working with generative computer vision models, preferably various forms of diffusion models.
5+ years of industry computer vision experience.
M.S. or PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, or related areas.
Nice to Have:
Publications at top ML conferences.
Experience using Cursor, Copilot, Codex, or similar AI coding assistants for development, debugging, testing, and refactoring.
Familiarity with LLM-powered productivity tools for documentation search, experiment analysis, SQL/data exploration, and engineering workflow acceleration.

Pinterest is looking for a Senior Manager, Ads Product Marketing - Ads Automation to lead a key area of our ads delivery and automation product marketing strategy. In this role, you will help shape how Pinterest brings automation solutions to market, enabling advertisers to better understand performance, value Pinterest media accurately, and improve business outcomes. You will work at the intersection of product, market, and customer needs, translating ads delivery and automation complexity into clear strategy, positioning, and go-to-market execution.

Manage and develop a team of PMMs responsible for complex, cross-functional automation and delivery initiatives

Partner with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing Science, and Business Development to align on priorities, readiness, and success metrics
Help advertisers maximize performance through adoption of our suite of automated solutions
Define and track success metrics for launches and ongoing adoption, using data and feedback to refine strategy over time
Build the processes, forums, and cross-functional operating rhythms needed to keep high-priority initiatives moving effectively
Translate complex ads delivery and optimization concepts into clear narratives for internal stakeholders, sales teams, and advertisers

The Ads Quality team helps Pinners move from inspiration to action by showing the right ad at the right time. The output of this work will both be highly impactful (driving measurable value for Pinners and Advertisers) and highly visible (your launches will change the way the app looks and feels), and will critically contribute to our mission of helping hundreds of millions of people find the inspiration to create a life they love.

Experience partnering with engineering, data science, analytics, research, or PMM cross-functional teams.
Evidence of the ability to define new products and strategies and to execute from ideation and multi-quarter roadmaps through go-to-market and adoption.

Leverage buy/build/partner approaches to move with speed.

Strong evidence of the ability to define new products and strategies in an ambiguous space and to execute from ideation and multi-quarter roadmaps through go-to-market and adoption.
Strong ability to empathize with, anticipate the needs of, and effectively collaborate with a diverse set of stakeholders, including advertisers, creators, Pinners, and internal partners.

Pinterest is looking for a Sr. Staff Qualitative Researcher to lead research in our highest-priority ads areas. We are looking for a seasoned researcher who can embed in complex, ambiguous problem spaces, uncover the advertiser and Pinner needs that matter most, and turn them into a clear learning agenda. In this role you’ll bring deep qual and mixed methods experience (as needed) to design, execute and communicate strategic research to senior stakeholders in the Ads org and beyond. You’ll shape strategy by partnering with Product, Design, and Engineering and presenting insights and written POVs directly to senior leadership. In this role, you’ll have ownership of a broad problem space, autonomy to set and execute your research agenda, and real influence over the ads roadmap and the holistic Pinner experience.
What you’ll do:
Lead high-impact qualitative research in our most strategic ads areas : Embed in one or two high-priority problem spaces and own the full research cycle from discovery through execution, delivery, and influence on product decisions.
Uncover and represent complex advertiser and user problems: Identify the deep, ambiguous customer needs that cut across the ads product, and translate them into clear opportunities for the business.
Shape the research agenda: Work with Product, Design, Engineering, Data Science, and quantitative UX Research to scope and prioritize the questions that matter most for the areas you support, and independently identify where research can have the greatest impact.
Choose the right method for the question: Plan, field, and synthesize research using the full range of qualitative methods, and partner with Data Science and quantitative researchers on mixed-methods studies that combine depth with scale.
Influence strategy and roadmap : Partner with PMs and Designers to deliver informed, actionable recommendations, and communicate insights directly to leadership to help shape product direction. Author written POVs and cross-study syntheses that connect findings into a bigger picture.
Assess where sustained research investment is needed: Evaluate whether an area warrants a long-term research presence, and make the case to leadership for where to invest.
Use AI to amplify your craft: . Bring creativity to how you apply AI tools to research workflows and to how you land learnings, making cross-functional collaboration faster and more effective.
Provide vision and direction for large collaborative efforts: Lead cross-team research initiatives across the ads organization (and as needed across ads and consumer orgs), setting direction and aligning partners around a shared point of view.
Mentor and raise the bar: Coach and develop other researchers, and elevate qualitative craft across the team.
What we’re looking for:
Minimum 7 years of experience in qualitative or mixed-methods user research, with a track record of leading research at a staff or senior staff level in a product organization, ideally in ads, marketplaces, or B2B/B2C platforms.
Deep expertise across the qualitative toolkit. Fluency in interviews, ethnography, diary studies, usability testing, concept testing, and other methods, with sound judgment about which approach best fits the question, timeline, and decision at hand.
Experience in mixed-methods research. Demonstrated success partnering with Data Science and quantitative UX Research to combine qualitative depth with quantitative scale, and to triangulate findings across data sources.
Demonstrated ability to influence product strategy and roadmap supported by strong storytelling and recommendations that can drive action
Strong executive communication skills and comfort presenting insights, written POVs, and recommendations to senior leaders (Sr. Directors +) and cross-functional partners, and tailoring the message to the audience.
Ability to thrive in ambiguity and take an unstructured, high-urgency problem space, define the right questions, and build a learning agenda with minimal direction.
Strong strategic judgment and decision quality to assess where research will have the greatest impact, prioritize accordingly, and make a clear case for where sustained investment is (or isn’t) warranted.
Proven ability to collaborate with PMs, Designers, Engineers, Data Scientists, and quantitative researchers, and to build trust and credibility across disciplines.
Experience leading large, collaborative research efforts with proven ability to set vision and direction across teams, align stakeholders around a shared point of view, and drive complex initiatives to completion.
Curiosity and creativity in using AI tools. Enthusiasm for applying AI to research workflows, from synthesis to storytelling, to work faster and land insights in more compelling ways. Working knowledge of standard AI based research tools and capabilities preferred.
Familiarity with ads (preferred). Understanding of advertiser needs, ad ecosystems and challenges is a plus, though not required.

As a Data Scientist in our Core organization - Trust and Safety + Content Quality, you will shape the future of people-facing and business-facing products we build at Pinterest. Your expertise in quantitative modeling, experimentation and algorithms will be utilized to solve some of the most complex engineering challenges at the company. You will collaborate on a wide array of product and business problems with a diverse set of cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Design, Research, Product Analytics, Data Engineering and others. The results of your work will influence and uplevel our product development teams while introducing greater scientific rigor into the real world products serving hundreds of millions of pinners, creators, advertisers and merchants around the world. The core mandate is to evolve the organization from reactive moderation and lagging harm reporting into a proactive, metrics-driven operating system—where we manage leading indicators that predict risk, improve understanding quality, and keep Pinterest safe, inspiring, and useful.
What you’ll do:
Develop a deep, nuanced understanding of the Pinterest trust and safety platform, quantifying full funnel opportunities and risks
Lead projects on: Trust and Safety opportunities across different funnel stages
Design and productionize robust, scalable ML and evaluation frameworks—spanning statistical measurement, product recommendation, and forecasting
Develop best practices for instrumentation and experimentation and communicate those to product engineering teams to help us fulfill our mission - to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love
Bring scientific rigor and statistical methods to the challenges of product creation, development and improvement with an appreciation for the behaviors of our Pinners
Build and prototype analysis pipelines iteratively to provide insights at scale while developing comprehensive knowledge of data structures and metrics, advocating for changes where needed for product development
Work cross-functionally to build and communicate key insights, and collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, designers, and researchers to help build the next experiences on Pinterest

Minimum 10 years of experience analyzing data in a fast-paced, data-driven environment with proven ability to apply scientific methods to solve real-world problems on web-scale data
Extensive experience solving analytical problems using quantitative approaches including in the fields of Machine Learning, Statistical Modeling, Forecasting, Econometrics or other related fields
A scientifically rigorous approach to analysis and data, and a well-tuned sense of skepticism, attention to detail and commitment to high-quality, results-oriented output
Ability to manipulate large data sets with high dimensionality and complexity; fluency in SQL (or other database languages) and a scripting language (Python or R)
Excellent communication skills and ability to explain learnings to both technical and non-technical partners
A team player who’s able to partner with cross-functional leadership to quickly turn insights into actions
Excellent communication and influencing skills
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field or equivalent experience

Lead multiple technical sub-areas within Growth content science effectively.

Set the technical direction and multi-quarter strategy for foundational ML capabilities across visual representation learning, multimodal content understanding, and LLM-based personalization.

Build reusable embeddings, representations, semantic signals, and ML infrastructure while advancing techniques such as VLMs, LLMs, sequence modeling, self-supervised learning, retrieval, and distillation.

MS or PhD degree in computer science, machine learning, or equivalent industry experience.

We’re hiring a Staff Machine Learning Engineer to help drive the future of merchant presence and shopping experiences on Pinterest.
This role sits on the Merchant team and focuses on building AI/ML systems (including LLMs) that identify, understand, and surface relevant, high-quality merchants across segments—so Pinners can discover new brands with greater confidence and consideration, and merchants can reach new, diverse audiences.
In this role, you’ll lead LLM-first, evaluation-driven initiatives—near-term focused on agentic workflows, measurement, and operational rigor that strengthen Merchant Integrity and Business Integrity. Longer term, you’ll help advance core relevance capabilities such as merchant/brand affinity modeling and related signals that improve shopping discovery across Pinterest. You’ll partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Data Science, Design, and platform teams to take systems from early prototypes to reliable, scaled production.
You will also serve as the technical lead for ML in this space—reporting to a Director and acting as the first ML Engineering hire in this org—helping define the technical roadmap, establish engineering standards, and lay the foundation for scaling the domain and team over time. This is a high-agency, high-impact role with direct levers on user trust, relevance, and shopping outcomes across high-traffic Pinterest surfaces (organic and paid).
What you’ll do:
Own end-to-end technical delivery for cross-team initiatives—from problem framing and technical strategy through architecture, implementation, rollout, monitoring, and iteration.
Set technical direction and execution plans in partnership with a Director and cross-functional leads, including defining milestones, sequencing, and quality bars for the domain.
Build and evolve ML and GenAI systems that improve merchant quality and understanding (e.g., merchant content enrichment, attribute extraction/normalization, entity resolution, merchant/brand quality signals, and policy-aware transformations), with clear downstream impact on retrieval, ranking, and shopping surfaces.
Establish robust evaluation and measurement practices across ML + LLM-assisted systems, including golden datasets, human-in-the-loop review loops, automated regression testing, offline/online metric alignment, and clear go/no-go launch criteria for quality, safety, and performance.
Design systems with strong attention to quality, cost, latency, reliability, and safety, including guardrails, fallbacks, caching, and observability to support scaled production operations.
Establish the ML engineering operating model for the org (where applicable): evaluation standards, launch readiness reviews, monitoring/alerting, and sustainable ownership practices to keep quality high as the roadmap scales.
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Design, Trust/Policy/Legal, and ML platform teams to align on goals, constraints, and rollout plans—and to turn ambiguous needs into concrete ML deliverables.
Drive experimentation and iteration (A/B tests, holdouts), lead error analysis, and translate learnings into measurable improvements to user trust and shopping outcomes.
Mentor and raise the bar for technical design, evaluation rigor, and production readiness across the team—enabling faster, safer iteration with AI/ML tooling and best practices.
Help scale the domain by supporting hiring and onboarding over time (e.g., interview loops, onboarding plans, technical mentorship), as we build out ML engineering capacity.
What we’re looking for:
8+ years of industry experience in ML engineering / applied ML / software engineering, including meaningful time operating as a Staff-level (or equivalent) IC delivering complex production systems.
Demonstrated ability to lead 0→1 ML/LLM efforts: taking ambiguous problem spaces, defining the approach, and delivering a production system with measurable impact.
Strong track record shipping ML-powered systems in domains such as recommendation, ranking, retrieval, content understanding, ads relevance, commerce, or adjacent areas with clear product impact.
Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications in production (or adjacent GenAI systems), with strong judgment on reliability, failure modes, rollout safety, and practical tradeoffs.
Deep experience with evaluation and measurement: dataset strategy, labeling/review operations, metric design, regression testing, and connecting offline improvements to online outcomes.
Strong systems design skills building data- and ML-intensive systems, with the ability to navigate tradeoffs in performance, reliability, scalability, and cost.
Strong communication skills and the ability to influence technical direction across teams without directly owning every implementation detail.
Demonstrated experience building and enhancing cross-functional partnerships with other teams and organizations.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field—or equivalent practical experience.

Pinterest is looking for a thoughtful, highly skilled Staff Motion Designer to join the Design Innovation team. You will define and evolve the motion design language that brings clarity, coherence, and delight to Pinterest across surfaces and flagship features. This is a hands-on, horizontal role for a rare blend of motion craft leader, systems thinker, and design technologist. You will establish reusable motion principles, patterns, tokens, and implementation guidance within the design system; partner directly with product and engineering teams to solve challenging interaction problems; and build tools and prototypes that make it easier to explore and ship exceptional motion at scale. Your impact will extend from the details of a single interaction to the cohesive experience of Pinterest as a whole.
What you’ll do
Define and evolve Pinterest’s motion design language – principles, interaction and transition patterns, timing and tokens, specifications, and guidance – so motion is intentional, coherent, accessible, and reusable across the product ecosystem.
Lead motion direction for flagship and AI-forward experiences, using motion to clarify state, cause and effect, hierarchy, feedback, progress, and system responsiveness.
Partner horizontally with product designers, engineers, product managers, researchers, and content designers to connect individual feature work to a shared motion strategy and raise the quality of shipped experiences.
Turn high-craft explorations into scalable design system contributions that reduce ad hoc implementation, improve consistency, and enable teams to move faster with confidence.
Rapidly prototype and validate motion ideas using the right medium – motion studies, design tools, code, AI-enabled tools, or custom prototypes – to create shared understanding and accelerate decisions.
Work closely with engineering throughout implementation to solve technically ambitious animation challenges while balancing performance, platform conventions, accessibility, and maintainability.
Develop or enable lightweight tools, templates, and workflows that help designers explore visual and motion ideas quickly and help engineering teams build sophisticated animations reliably.
Stay at the leading edge of AI-enabled motion and visual-creation tools, applying them strategically to improve ideation, prototyping, and production while maintaining critical thinking, quality validation, and ownership of final outcomes.
Conduct motion quality reviews, give actionable feedback on designs and implementations, and mentor designers in motion principles, systems thinking, prototype craft, and productive engineering partnership.
Clearly articulate the rationale, tradeoffs, and user impact behind motion decisions to teams, leaders, and executives; build alignment around a high bar for motion craft and system quality.
What we’re looking for
Minimum 8 years of experience in motion design, product design, interaction design, or a closely related discipline, with a portfolio demonstrating exceptional motion craft in shipped digital products or platforms.
A staff/principal-level track record of influencing horizontally across teams, shaping a product or design-system direction, and raising quality without relying on formal authority.
Deep command of motion and interaction design principles, including timing, choreography, easing, spring behavior, feedback, and transitions – and strong judgment about when motion improves usability, comprehension, emotion, and trust.
Experience creating or materially evolving scalable motion systems, such as principles, token sets, pattern libraries, documentation, tooling, and governance that teams can adopt across products and platforms.
Demonstrated experience partnering closely with engineers to implement complex motion; practical fluency in performance, technical constraints, platform conventions, handoff, and quality assurance.
A design technologist mindset: comfortable using prototyping tools, AI, and code or technical workflows where useful to explore ideas, communicate intent, and improve how teams design and build.
Strong product and systems thinking: able to connect craft decisions to user needs, product strategy, accessibility, implementation efficiency, and measurable impact.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to synthesize ambiguity, create clear documentation, facilitate constructive critique, and align diverse cross-functional partners.
A collaborative, low-ego working style with a passion for learning, experimentation, mentoring, and inclusive design. You consider reduced-motion preferences, cognitive load, and diverse user needs from the beginning of the design process.
Bachelor’s degree in design, animation, human-computer interaction, a related field, or equivalent experience.
Bonus Points For
Experience defining motion for AI, conversational, multimodal, or other emerging product experiences.
Experience contributing to platform-wide design systems, public motion systems, or open-source animation libraries.
Experience building designer-facing or engineer-facing tools that improve motion prototyping, handoff, or implementation quality.
Experience in large-scale consumer products, personalization, or rapid experimentation environments.
Join us to define the motion language that makes Pinterest’s next generation of products feel clear, capable, and unmistakably Pinterest—raising the bar for craft, trust, and coherence for millions of Pinners.

Pinterest is uniquely positioned across the consumer journey – from inspiration and discovery through consideration, purchase, and long-term customer relationships. Pinners’ commercial intent and engagement create valuable signals that can help advertisers better understand and improve their performance. This role will define how Pinterest applies identity, conversion, and measurement signals to help advertisers identify and acquire new customers, measure incremental outcomes, and optimize campaign bidding. By connecting measurement insights with campaign decisioning, this leader will help advertisers maximize business outcomes and strengthen Pinterest’s differentiation in the ads ecosystem.
The ideal candidate is a Staff-level product leader with substantial experience in ads measurement, optimization, or adjacent advertising technology. They deeply understand how advertisers set growth objectives, distinguish acquisition from retention, evaluate incrementality, and translate insights into campaign and bidding decisions. They have strong quantitative and technical fluency across attribution, experimentation, causal measurement, customer-lifecycle signals, and ads optimization. They excel at partnering cross-functionally with engineering, data science, research, PMM, sales, and other teams to transform complex sigånals and methodologies into credible, actionable, privacy-durable, and scalable products.
What you’ll do:
Own the strategy and end-to-end execution for products that apply Pinterest’s identity, conversion, and measurement signals to improve advertiser outcomes across new-customer acquisition, incrementality, and bidding optimization.
Partner closely with engineering, data science, design, research, PMM, sales, partnerships, legal, privacy, and policy/integrity to deliver solutions with strong product-market fit, methodological rigor, regulatory compliance, and long-term durability.
Build a comprehensive suite of products that helps drive incremental reach and performance for Pinterest advertisers.
What we’re looking for:
8+ years of experience working as a Product Manager or in a related role, including 3–5+ years of substantial ads or marketing measurement experience.
Strong evidence of the ability to define new products and strategies in an ambiguous space and execute from ideation and multi-quarter roadmaps through go-to-market and adoption.
Deep understanding of identity and first-person data, how advertisers establish objectives and deploy tactics, and how they evaluate outcomes across awareness, consideration, intent, conversion, and long-term value.
Experience working with engineering, data science, analytics, research, or PMM cross-functional teams and a strong ability to empathize with, anticipate the needs of, and collaborate with a diverse set of stakeholders.
Strong quantitative judgment and understanding of attribution, incrementality, experimentation, brand lift, conversion lift, and measurement tradeoffs.

Billions of dollars flow through Retail Media Networks (RMNs) onto advertising platforms like Pinterest every year, but it can be a sub-par experience for the RMN, the brand advertiser, and for Pinterest. The RMN’s fees are hidden, campaign setup and management is manual and slow, and Pinterest gets left out of most of the relationship. Pinterest Media Network Connect (PMNC) is Pinterest’s solution to this problem, with complete transparency and self-service capabilities. Pinterest was the first to do this style of solution to the problem, and it is being copied by larger adverting platforms as a result, so we know we’re on the right path.
But changing the retail media network business is not enough. We have ambitions to support a fully transparent, fully self-service audience marketplace, where anyone can transact with anyone else to empower their campaigns with audiences that enhance their performance and reach.
You, as the lead for PMNC and audience marketplace, will grow our RMN offerings and build the audience marketplace business from the ground up. Leading these products involves collaborating with a dynamic, motivated, and expert team of cross functional partners to build brand new systems, develop relationships with partners, automate processes, and champion our solutions internally. Your success will depend on leading the company through significant process changes, having deep empathy for our partners and advertisers, partnering with many stakeholders internally and externally.
What you’ll do:
Grow and lead our PMNC business to a billion+ dollars of revenue.
Build a new audience marketplace offering from scratch into an industry-leading solution.
Lead product vision, strategy, technical development, and execution for PMNC and our audience marketplace business.
Develop a deep understanding of the business’s workflows, and automate what will make the business run better and faster.
Design and build billing user interfaces – both internal and external – for delightful experiences.
Translate insights into clear product requirements and collaborate with engineering, design, data analytics, marketing, research, and other product teams to drive measurable impact.
Communicate your strategy internally to ensure alignment, secure resources, and champion the roadmap’s vision.
Leverage AI to turbo-charge your own work, from writing to design to prototyping, and more.
What we’re looking for:
Experience with retail media network solutions, audience marketplaces is a big plus.
Excellent communication and stakeholder alignment skills.
Proven ability to shepherd large cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
Strong analytical mindset, using data to guide decisions and optimize workflows.
Extreme attention to detail and meticulous design sense.
Track record of rapidly delivering user-focused solutions in a cross-functional setting.
Location around SF, NYC, or Palo Alto.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, or equivalent experience

Job Title: Staff Software Engineer, Edge Team.
Intro : The Edge team owns the systems (including CDN, TLS, DNS, ingress/egress proxy fleet, and rate limiting) that connect 600M+ users to Pinterest. We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to lead our efforts to manage automation traffic (such as bots and crawlers) at the Edge, while shaping the future of our rate limiting platform..
What you’ll do:
Build Edge systems that combine in-house implementation, open-source software like Envoy proxy, and multiple CDN & DNS providers. Balance what to build, what to leverage from the community, and what to orchestrate across vendors.
Drive automation traffic management efforts in the Edge space, designing solutions to manage bots and crawlers at scale.
Design and implement request processing logic in Envoy to support Edge capabilities such as routing, traffic classification, and enforcement. Write, review, and maintain code written in C++, Golang, and Python.
Collaborate with CDN vendors and internal platform teams to define integration points.
Study internal user pain points with the rate limiting platform and translate findings into a prioritized roadmap.
Mentor engineers within the team and demonstrate technical leadership through design reviews, pairing, and coaching.
Use AI to accelerate prototyping, analysis, and operational tasks, while applying engineering judgment to verify correctness and production-readiness
Participate in oncall for Edge systems and drive incident response, post-mortems, and reliability improvements.

6+ years of experience in infrastructure, networking, or platform engineering, with a deep focus on traffic management systems (CDN, HTTP gateways, service mesh, or load balancing).
Experience with bot detection, scraping prevention, or automation traffic management systems is a plus.
Proficiency in C++, Golang, or Python, with experience developing L7 HTTP proxies such as Envoy, Nginx, Varnish, and Traefik.
